description: Source code for ResourceManager plugin handling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and security token management within WPEFramework, including RPC registration and external API interactions.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class managing AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and security tokens, with RPC registration and external API calls.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class for making JSON RPC calls to other services within the framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceManager, sets security token, and registers RPC methods.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to set AV blocked status for an app.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to retrieve list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to reserve TTS resource for an app.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets AV blocked status for a specific callsign.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves list of applications currently blocked from AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a given client application.
